summary: Execute namespace bodies in source order.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: order
tests.input: let a:number[]=[]; namespace N { a.push(1) }; namespace N { a.push(2) }; console.log(a.join(','));

tests.name: sequential augmentation
tests.input: namespace N { export const a=1 }; namespace N { export const b=N.a+1 }; console.log(N.b);
